handoff_instructions: M3-T10 done: added AnthropicStructuredExtractor (packages/integrations/src/adapters/anthropic-structured-extractor.ts), a real StructuredExtractor<FieldCaptureExtraction> implementation calling the Anthropic Messages API (POST /v1/messages) with a forced tool_choice on a `record_field_capture_extraction` tool whose input_schema is generated from fieldCaptureExtractionSchema via z.toJSONSchema (same pattern as packages/workflows/src/receptionist-runtime.ts). The system prompt is versioned via FIELD_CAPTURE_PROMPT_VERSION = "field-capture-v1" (carried in modelVersion as `anthropic:<model>:<promptVersion>`), contains no secrets and makes no authorization decisions -- it only proposes facts with per-field confidence and evidence, matching CLAUDE.md rule 14 (ambiguous input lowers confidence or becomes an unresolvedQuestion, never a guess). A response with no matching tool_use block, or whose tool input fails fieldCaptureExtractionSchema validation, throws rather than returning a best-effort guess. Added anthropicStructuredExtractorFromEnv(env) which reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (and optional ANTHROPIC_MODEL) only from the passed-in env object and throws ProviderConfigError (reused from ./runtime-config) if the key is missing -- no key is ever hardcoded or defaulted. Non-2xx and thrown-fetch handling reuse errorForResponse/providerFetch from ./outcomes, exactly like the Twilio/Vapi adapters, so 429s are rejected+retryable and 5xx/timeouts are ambiguous. Exported from packages/integrations/src/index.ts. New test/anthropic-structured-extractor.test.ts mocks fetch (no network, no real key) to check: the request shape (system prompt, forced tool_choice, generated input_schema, headers, configurable model/apiBaseUrl), that the M3 acceptance extraction round-trips through the mocked tool_use response, the two guess-refusal error paths above, HTTP-status classification (429/500), timeout classification, and anthropicStructuredExtractorFromEnv's env-only key reading (present/absent/model override). pnpm format:check, lint, typecheck and test all pass repo-wide. Next: M3-T11 "Job matching" (match extracted jobRef values like "Wilson" to active jobs by job/customer name within the org; ambiguous or none -> clarification task).
